title: ウクライナで見本市 義手や義足の人などのファッションに注目
summary: ウクライナでは、ロシアによる軍事侵攻で障害を負った兵士や市民が増える中、首都キーウでファッションの見本市が開かれ、義手や義足の人などでも身につけやすい衣服や靴が注目されています。

title: 北方領土元島民のひ孫ら「北方墓参」再開を高市首相に要望
summary: 北方領土の元島民のひ孫にあたる北海道の中学生らが、総理大臣官邸を訪れて高市総理大臣と面会し、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻の影響で見送られている元島民による「北方墓参」の再開などを要望しました。

title: Middle East crisis: Humanitarian fallout ‘worsening by the day’
summary: The humanitarian toll is mounting as fighting continues in the Middle East beyond strikes and counterstrikes between the US and Iran, the UN aid coordination office OCHA warned on Thursday, with civilians increasingly at risk and essential infrastructure disrupted in several countries across the region.

title: Attacks ‘getting worse’: Deadly Russian strikes hit Ukrainian cities
summary: Aid workers and first responders raced to help people across Ukraine after a wave of deadly Russian missile and drone strikes overnight as concerns mounted over military activity near nuclear power plants on Thursday.

title: Returning Afghans face growing risk of trafficking as crises deepen
summary: Afghans returning from neighbouring countries are facing growing risks of human trafficking and exploitation as overlapping humanitarian and economic crises leave many struggling to survive, the UN warned on Thursday.

title: 米大統領「イランを激しく攻撃する」 攻撃の応酬再燃に懸念
summary: アメリカのトランプ大統領は、イランが中東に駐留しているアメリカ軍に攻撃を試みたことに触れ「われわれはイランを激しく攻撃する」と述べ、イランに対する報復攻撃に踏み切る考えを示しました。アメリカとイランの間で再び攻撃の応酬がエスカレートする懸念が高まっています。

title: ゼレンスキー大統領「迎撃ミサイル300発必要」支援訴え
summary: ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、アメリカメディアとのインタビューで、ロシア軍が弾道ミサイルを使用した大規模攻撃を繰り返していると指摘するとともに、防空システム「パトリオット」用の迎撃ミサイル300発が必要だとして、支援を訴えました。

title: World News in Brief: Rohingya refugees, Bahá’ís in Iran, disarmament in the Central African Republic
summary: Independent UN experts on Wednesday called for urgent action to support Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh after reports indicated two boats carrying more than 500 passengers may have capsized off the coast of Myanmar in mid-July.

title: Cyprus: Guterres calls for renewed trust and a new meeting on the way forward
summary: The United Nations Secretary-General said on Wednesday that he plans to convene fresh talks on Cyprus to resolve the decades-long division on the Mediterranean island, stressing that the moment calls for rebuilding trust between its two communities.

title: Hunger hampers Ebola response as cases top 3,200 in DR Congo
summary: The UN emergency food agency appealed for immediate funding on Wednesday, warning that deepening hunger is undermining the response to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) that has now infected more than 3,200 people.

title: UN warns West Bank settler violence hits ‘all-time high’ as calls grow to end occupation
summary: Violence in the occupied West Bank is worsening as the Israeli Government continues to approve new settlements while settlers and Israeli security forces have “often” acted together to attack local Palestinian communities, the UN’s human rights office (OHCHR) warned on Wednesday.
